description: This is a shell script used for managing a sports telecast database, including functions for migrations, resets, status checks, backups, and configuration management.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints informational messages in green color.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Prints warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Prints error messages in red color.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL is accessible and running.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file on the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a table to track executed migrations.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been executed.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution of a migration in the migration history table.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Resets the database by dropping all tables and types.

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays the current status of the database, including tables and migration history.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database using pg_dump.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help information and usage instructions.
